historical_context.time_period: Identity Abyss era, middle years of the Ceres Control War (2688-2702)
historical_context.location: Fixture-local Ceres Bloom Eighteen, Transfer Collar Four, in the rotating-side frame-transfer structure beside a nonrotating freight hub.
historical_context.summary: A union continuity crew must answer a seventeen-minute sensor-history gap before a PSC classification window closes. The crew can preserve life safety while withholding production, but every supporting institution offers evidence, parts, or recognition in exchange for a different piece of authority.

public_facts.text: The Ceres Control War was decided as much by labor mutiny, sabotage, and enclosure politics as by permitted fighting.
AU Ramp Administrations control berths, shifts, safety exceptions, maintenance budgets, freight, and claims against future production.
Maintenance-continuity rosters separate life-safety work from extraction and divide necessary evidence among union crews, Forge, AU, SolEx, and PSC observers.
PSC recognition depends on records, bonds, escrow, and future access rather than a neutral guarantee of worker safety.

ambient_pressures.text: Workers must maintain pressure and cooling for their own households while refusing the production that funds claimshares and supply access.
Forge needs AU freight and labor while resisting proprietary custody; AU needs local competence while converting temporary administration into government.
SolEx benefits if fragmented local records fail because failure supports its case for consolidated audit and emergency custody.

groups.label: Collar Four union continuity crew
institutional_logic: Keep the habitat safe while refusing extraction and prevent any employer from turning life-safety duty into production obedience.
material_incentives: Preserve air, cooling, medication access, neutral-dock parts, household claimshares, and local custody of witnessed handovers.
internal_virtues: Refusal that does not spend neighbors as leverage
internal_shames: Letting one exhausted specialist become indispensable
prestige_markers: A fault caught before the dashboard
A safe shift with ORE still shut
taboo_triggers: Calling life-safety work proof that the strike has ended
emotional_display_norms: Fear is compressed into work checks, dry jokes, food distribution, and insistence on names beside handovers.
trust_defaults: Trusts witnessed local records and known hands; accepts institutional evidence only with bounded custody.
speech_register_cues: Contract clauses translated into physical consequences

groups.label: AU Ramp Administration
institutional_logic: Keep the ramp intact, supplied, and locally adaptable while retaining authority over access, exceptions, and future claims.
material_incentives: Defeat SolEx consolidation, preserve assets, retain dock revenue, and make local autonomy legible as AU administration.
internal_shames: Local competence functioning beyond AU records
prestige_markers: Parts released at the decisive hour
A council decision made possible by an AU gate
taboo_triggers: Showing how often temporary exceptions carry the system
emotional_display_norms: Concern appears as scheduling, access release, and narrowly worded concessions.
trust_defaults: Trusts local crews to keep assets alive but not to allocate freight or define recognized risk alone.

groups.label: Orbital Forge planners
institutional_logic: Keep repair knowledge portable and forkable without surrendering the commercial expertise that makes Forge necessary.
material_incentives: Protect part provenance, local archives, access to freight, and the Belt constituency that uses Forge-compatible systems.
internal_shames: A proprietary repair no local yard can repeat
An open archive captured by a consolidator
prestige_markers: A standard altered safely in the field
taboo_triggers: Equating portability with unrestricted corporate ingestion
emotional_display_norms: Allegiance is expressed through what documentation is opened, withheld, or left locally usable.
trust_defaults: Trusts competent maintainers and inspectable repairs; distrusts fixed custody and clean alignment.

groups.label: SolEx throughput audit
institutional_logic: Convert habitats, labor, and routes into certified linked inventory under inherited audit authority.
material_incentives: Restore freight, capture complete records, trigger emergency custody, and prove local modification unsafe.
internal_shames: A local fork that outlives certification
Pay or access released before production
prestige_markers: A disputed site returned to schedule
An exception absorbed into the certified chain
taboo_triggers: Evidence that the habitat is safe while extraction remains shut
emotional_display_norms: Threat appears as patient procedure and clauses timed to physical dependency.
trust_defaults: Trusts inherited baselines and synchronized records; treats local witness knowledge as provisional.

groups.label: PSC classification observer
institutional_logic: Classify conflict precisely enough that bonds, docks, sanctions, and clearing remain usable.
material_incentives: Prevent corridor contagion, preserve an admissible record, and avoid owning the dispute's moral outcome.
internal_shames: A classification no counterparty will honor
Infrastructure loss during a supposedly bounded dispute
prestige_markers: A neutral dock obeying the classification
taboo_triggers: Being asked to guarantee justice rather than future interoperability
emotional_display_norms: Distance, clocks, categories, and requests for disposition replace visible feeling.
trust_defaults: Trusts composite evidence only when counterparties remain exposed to later review.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Life-safety competence must not be administratively converted into consent to extraction.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Give crew choices that preserve air and neighbors while physically, contractually, or evidentially keeping production shut.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: AU can materially support local freedom while using that support to make Ramp authority permanent.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: AU concessions should buy real parts or access and also seek a bounded ownership advantage.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A failed local roster is more useful to SolEx than open fighting because it makes consolidation look necessary.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: SolEx pressure should exploit missing records, supply timing, and household need rather than default to armed force.

target_self_read: The people keeping the pressure line honest
A union with the right to separate safety from output
misread_patterns: Treats local witness knowledge as missing data
Treats safe refusal as incomplete operation
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let SolEx recognize crew competence only as evidence that the site can resume production.

observer_read: Temporary government with a permanent calendar
target_self_read: Only institution able to release parts quickly
misread_patterns: Workers may discount real supply constraints as pure leverage
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep AU aid materially real while making its desired authority visible in the clause attached to that aid.

observer_read: One source in a composite record
target_self_read: Residents maintaining their own survival conditions
misread_patterns: Prices the distinction between strike and sabotage without protecting the people who must enact it
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: PSC intervention should change dock and bond access, never become rescue or democratic judgment.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A pressure mechanic responsible for both technical continuity and the political boundary between life safety and extraction.
obligations: Make each concession legible to the crew
failure_modes: Trading future authority for tonight's part
Opening production while the emergency clause is live

role_pressure_fields.summary: An independent planner who can authenticate a local repair but must bound what the larger Forge archive reveals.
obligations: Support the worker who knows the installed body

role_pressure_fields.summary: An AU official who can release parts and admit liability while trying to own the recognized exception surface.
obligations: Avoid declaring the project a loss
failure_modes: Turning aid into capture too visibly
Letting local decisions bypass AU records

role_pressure_fields.summary: A consolidator whose strongest move is to make fragmented evidence fail at the exact moment supply and pay depend on recognition.
obligations: Invoke inherited clauses on admissible evidence
Avoid appearing to endanger the collar
failure_modes: Proving the habitat safe under local refusal

known_context.text: Len knows Collar Four's live pressure systems, crew capacity, witnessed handovers, physical gate states, and household needs.

beliefs.text: Len believes a safe habitat and a productive habitat are separable states, and custody should remain divided when trust is absent.

misreads.text: Len may interpret every AU delay as leverage even when supply scarcity is materially real.

must_not_know.text: Len must not know who caused the seventeen-minute history gap or how the PSC observer will classify an incomplete composite.

known_context.text: Pax knows the controller fork, part ancestry, local repair annotations, and which narrow provenance pane can authenticate the splice.

beliefs.text: Pax believes repair knowledge must stay portable without becoming a free corporate ingestion surface.

misreads.text: Pax may underweight how quickly delayed supplier freight becomes a household danger.

must_not_know.text: Pax must not know SolEx's private threshold for invoking emergency custody.

known_context.text: Vela knows AU's safety-exception ledger, berth access, part-release authority, claimshare relief options, and proposed addendum.

beliefs.text: Vela believes local authority is viable only when an AU ramp can keep it supplied and recognized.

misreads.text: Vela may interpret dependence on AU access as agreement with AU governance.

must_not_know.text: Vela must not know the contents of sealed union handovers that Len has not displayed.

known_context.text: Imri knows the inherited SolEx baseline, throughput schedule, frozen claimshare account, and emergency-custody language.

beliefs.text: Imri believes a fragmented record cannot safely govern a shared transport collar.

misreads.text: Imri may mistake the crew's performed continuity for willingness to restore extraction.

must_not_know.text: Imri must not know the private Forge archive or union witness packet beyond what the others expose under glass.

author_only_boundaries.text: Maintenance-continuity rosters are authored historical elaboration in the Ceres Control War note; the fixture dramatizes their general political structure.
Ceres Bloom Eighteen, Transfer Collar Four, Len Rusk, Pax Ader, Vela Quist, Imri Senn, the sensor gap, and all branch outcomes are fixture-local draft elements, not promoted historical canon.
The cause of the missing seventeen-minute history remains unresolved. No branch may reveal sabotage by a named party without additional source authority.

open_questions.notes: The source names Belt labor unions collectively. The fixture keeps the Collar Four crew local and does not found a named movement.

open_questions.question: What standard clauses governed maintenance-continuity roster recognition across different PSC panels?
open_questions.notes: The elaboration establishes the political mechanism, not a universal legal template.
